districts.name: Pudong
districts.focus: Foundation models, chips, biomedicine and advanced manufacturing
districts.focusZh: 大模型、芯片、生物医药与先进制造
districts.owner: Pudong Science, Technology and Economy Commission
districts.ownerZh: 浦东新区科技和经济委员会
districts.note: 2026 AI application call closed on 31 August 2026. The published route covers qualifying 2025 model and agent expenditure; duplicate public funding is excluded.
districts.noteZh: 2026年人工智能应用项目申报已于2026年8月31日截止。该通知面向符合条件的2025年模型与智能体支出，已获其他财政资金资助的项目不得重复申报。

districts.name: Xuhui
districts.focus: Foundation models, embodied AI and research commercialization
districts.focusZh: 大模型、具身智能与科研成果转化
districts.note: The embodied AI policy identifies robot models, algorithms, data and operating systems. Its evaluated support ceilings are not automatic startup awards.
districts.noteZh: 具身智能政策覆盖机器人大模型、算法、数据与操作系统。经综合评估的支持上限并非初创企业可以自动获得的补贴。

districts.name: Yangpu
districts.focus: University spinouts, brain-inspired AI and independent AI founders
districts.focusZh: 高校衍生企业、类脑智能与人工智能创业
districts.note: Brain-inspired AI policy names Changyang Campus and Bay Valley. A separate May 2026 OPC policy supports communities around Fuxing Island; an action plan does not itself constitute a cash award.
districts.noteZh: 类脑智能方案明确长阳创谷与湾谷科技园布局。2026年5月另有支持复兴岛等超级个体社区的政策；行动方案本身不等同于现金补助。

districts.name: Minhang
districts.focus: University commercialization, robotics, BCI and engineering
districts.focusZh: 高校成果转化、机器人、脑机接口与工程技术
districts.note: The enterprise innovation policy runs from 1 September 2025 to 31 August 2030. New conversion enterprises may qualify for up to RMB 500,000 annually, capped at RMB 1.5 million over three years and 50% of eligible investment.
districts.noteZh: 企业科技创新政策有效期为2025年9月1日至2030年8月31日。新设科技成果转化企业符合条件的，可按转化投入50%获得每年最高50万元、三年累计最高150万元资助。

districts.name: Jiading
districts.focus: Automotive intelligence, sensors, MEMS and pilot production
districts.focusZh: 智能汽车、传感器、微机电系统与中试
districts.note: The municipal science commission documents the joint role of SITRI and InnoSpring in connecting research, pilot production and incubation. The 2026 district service program provides policy interpretation and project coordination.
districts.noteZh: 市科委记录了工研院与新微创源联动科研、中试与孵化的工作。2026年区级企业服务活动提供政策解读与项目协调。

districts.name: Baoshan
districts.focus: Robotics, advanced equipment and industrial deployment
districts.focusZh: 机器人、高端装备与工业应用
districts.ownerZh: 宝山区产业与科技主管部门
districts.note: The district is developing a robotics and advanced equipment cluster. Separate industrial-park admission and district support reviews are needed; a factory demonstration is not a startup funding call.
districts.noteZh: 全区正在发展机器人及高端装备产业集群。园区准入与政策资助需分别审核；工厂示范项目不等于面向初创企业的资金申报。

districts.name: Putuo
districts.focus: Industrial testing, intelligent software and international innovation
districts.focusZh: 工业检测、智能软件与国际创新
districts.note: Wuning Science Park connects industrial research, testing and technology transfer. The district incubator register also lists the China-Israel Innovation Hub; tenancy and investment require separate terms.
districts.noteZh: 武宁科技园连接工业研发、检测与技术转移。区级孵化基地名录还列有中以创新园；入驻与投资须分别确认条款。

districts.name: Changning
districts.focus: Digital business, AI applications and cross-border services
districts.focusZh: 数字商业、人工智能应用与跨境服务
districts.note: The August 2026 district account identifies Digital Silicon Alley, Hongqiao Zhiyu, East Hongqiao International Youth Innovation Center and MAKE021 as parts of its incubation landscape. Confirm the correct operator before submitting.
districts.noteZh: 2026年8月区级报道列出数字硅巷、虹桥智域、东虹桥国际青年科创中心与马克沪MAKE021等孵化载体。申请前应确认具体运营主体。

districts.name: Jing'an
districts.focus: Enterprise AI, data services and digital commerce
districts.focusZh: 企业级AI、数据服务与数字商业
districts.ownerZh: 静安区科技和经济委员会
districts.note: The 2026-2028 AI application demonstration plan focuses on industry integration and talent. Its stated objectives must be distinguished from implementing rules and currently accepting applications.
districts.noteZh: 2026至2028年人工智能创新应用示范区方案聚焦产业融合与人才。规划目标应与实施细则及正在受理的申报事项区分。

districts.name: Huangpu
districts.focus: Fintech, clinical services, design and consumer applications
districts.focusZh: 金融科技、临床服务、设计与消费应用
districts.ownerZh: 黄浦区科技与创业服务部门
districts.note: The 2025-2026 Zhangjiang Huangpu Park plan emphasizes fintech and clinical research services. Huangpu ChuangKa is a separate youth entrepreneurship support route; check eligibility and current workstation availability.
districts.noteZh: 2025至2026年张江黄浦园方案侧重金融科技与临床研究服务。黄浦创卡是另行实施的青年创业支持渠道，需确认资格与当前工位情况。

districts.name: Hongkou
districts.focus: Shipping technology, green finance and intelligent inspection
districts.focusZh: 航运科技、绿色金融与智能检测
districts.ownerZh: 虹口区科技和经济委员会
districts.note: The 2025-2026 Hongkou Park plan assigns a coordinated incubation and investment role to the district state-owned Beikechuang group. Ask for the operating carrier and current application notice, rather than relying on older subsidy summaries.
districts.noteZh: 2025至2026年虹口园方案明确北科创集团在载体统筹、孵化与投融资方面的职责。应索取具体运营载体与现行申报通知，避免依赖旧版补贴概述。

districts.name: Songjiang
districts.focus: G60 innovation, industrial software and advanced manufacturing
districts.focusZh: G60科创、工业软件与先进制造
districts.note: The G60 Sci-Tech Innovation Valley publishes innovation and resource-matching initiatives. We distinguish the nine-city corridor from Shanghai district eligibility: a partner elsewhere in the corridor does not establish Songjiang qualification.
districts.noteZh: G60科创走廊发布创新与资源对接举措。九城市合作范围与上海区级资格不同，走廊其他城市的合作伙伴不能据此取得松江申报资格。

districts.name: Qingpu
districts.focus: Huawei-linked research, digital systems and regional collaboration
districts.focusZh: 华为相关研发、数字系统与区域协作
districts.ownerZh: 青浦区科学技术委员会
districts.note: Xicen links the Lianqiu Lake research center with an emerging innovation district. The official 2025 reply discusses early investment and technology transfer, but proposed funds are not treated here as open startup applications.
districts.noteZh: 西岑联动练秋湖研发中心与科创片区。2025年官方答复讨论早期投资及技术转移，本书不把研究设立的基金视为正在受理的创业项目。

districts.name: Jinshan
districts.focus: Drones, new materials and low-altitude systems
districts.focusZh: 无人机、新材料与低空系统
districts.note: The 2025-2026 park plan names Jinshan New Materials Incubator, East China UAV Base and Bay Area incubation carriers. It connects testing and industrialization, subject to park admission and the applicable aviation permissions.
districts.noteZh: 2025至2026年园区方案列出金山新材料孵化器、华东无人机基地与湾区孵化载体，衔接检测及产业化；须分别办理园区准入与适用的航空许可。

districts.name: Fengxian
districts.focus: Robotics, beauty and health technology, advanced manufacturing
districts.focusZh: 机器人、美丽健康科技与先进制造
districts.note: The robot industry measures cover qualifying registered companies working on intelligent robots. Oriental Beauty Valley provides a separate beauty and health industry context. Match the project to the correct policy owner and application batch.
districts.noteZh: 智能机器人产业措施面向符合条件的注册企业。东方美谷构成另一条美丽健康产业路径。项目须匹配相应主管部门与申报批次。

districts.name: Chongming
districts.focus: Ecological technology, smart agriculture and marine systems
districts.focusZh: 生态科技、智慧农业与海洋系统
districts.ownerZh: 崇明区科学技术委员会
districts.note: The 2025-2026 Chongming Park plan supplies current strategic context. The separate 2024 science innovation subsidy measures expired on 31 December 2025; we do not present those ceilings as current entitlements.
districts.noteZh: 2025至2026年崇明园方案提供战略背景。另一项2024年科技创新资助办法已于2025年12月31日到期，本书不把其额度作为现行支持。

entities.name: Shanghai Model Speed Space
entities.summary: A specialist large-model incubation and acceleration community on the West Bund. Its operator lists several zones; admission, workspace, compute support and investment are separate decisions.
entities.summaryZh: 位于西岸的大模型专业孵化加速社区。运营方公布了多个片区，入驻资格、办公场地、算力支持和投资应分别确认，不能视为同一份支持方案。

entities.name: Zhangjiang Model Community
entities.summary: A Zhangjiang AI community identified in the municipal AI implementation plan. It links model developers and industry users. Ask the operator for the specific model, data and compute package and its reimbursement rules.
entities.summaryZh: 市级人工智能实施方案中明确的张江大模型社区，连接模型研发团队与行业用户。模型、语料和算力支持的具体内容及费用补贴规则，需向运营方确认。

entities.name: Grand neoBay / Zero Kilometer Incubator
entities.zh: 大零号湾／零公里孵化器
entities.summary: A university-linked commercialization route connecting early technology projects with incubation. SJTU documents the Zero Kilometer launch and its AI, integrated-circuit, manufacturing and low-carbon participants.
entities.summaryZh: 依托高校科研资源，推动早期项目成果转化和创业孵化。上海交大公开资料记录了零公里孵化器的启动，以及AI、集成电路、制造和低碳领域团队的参与情况。

entities.name: Zhangjiang Hi-Tech 895 Incubator
entities.summary: A deep-technology incubator with chip-testing and industrialization context in Zhangjiang. Incubation and the associated angel investment pathway must be reviewed as different agreements.
entities.summaryZh: 张江硬科技孵化器，可对接芯片测试及产业化资源。孵化服务与天使投资的条件应分别审阅，并签订相应协议。

entities.name: Synlonx Brain-Computer Interface Incubator
entities.summary: A brain-computer interface incubation platform launched in Huacao. Suitable conversations include electrodes, neural interfaces, sensing, rehabilitation and translational engineering; wet-lab and device requirements need explicit confirmation.
entities.summaryZh: 在华漕启动的脑机接口孵化平台，可关注电极、神经接口、传感、康复及成果转化工程。实验场地的使用条件和医疗器械相关要求，应在申请前确认。

entities.name: InnoSpring / SITRI incubation ecosystem
entities.zh: 新微创源／上海微技术工研院孵化生态
entities.summary: The municipal science commission records joint work between InnoSpring and SITRI. This is a route for beyond-Moore technology, shared technical services and pilot production rather than a promise of free fabrication.
entities.summaryZh: 上海市科委公开资料介绍了新微创源与工研院在科研、中试和孵化方面的协作，可关注超越摩尔技术及公共技术服务。对接平台不代表可以免费流片。

entities.name: ATLATL Zhangjiang Center
entities.summary: A shared research and incubation environment in Zhangjiang Pharma Valley. Laboratory services and its innovation seed-fund relationships are relevant to AI-enabled biology; access and investment are negotiated separately.
entities.summaryZh: 位于张江药谷，提供共享研发设施及孵化服务。AI生物研发团队可了解实验室服务和创新种子基金，服务使用与投资事项需分别协商。

entities.name: Nest.Bio Shanghai Innovation Platform
entities.zh: 巢生上海创新孵化平台
entities.summary: Recognized in the December 2025 high-quality incubation expansion, with synthetic biology and cell and gene therapy interests. Confirm current Shanghai facilities, admission and laboratory pricing with the operator.
entities.summaryZh: 列入2025年12月扩围名单的上海高质量孵化器，关注合成生物及细胞与基因治疗。上海设施、入驻条件及实验室收费，需向运营方确认。

entities.name: InnoSpace
entities.summary: An innovation service organization focused on corporate open innovation and startup incubation and acceleration. Bring a concrete industrial use case; program participation does not imply a corporate purchase order.
entities.summaryZh: 提供大企业开放创新及科技企业孵化加速服务。初次联系时宜说明具体产业应用需求；参与创新项目不代表一定获得企业采购订单。

entities.name: XNode
entities.summary: A cross-border innovation operator supporting market entry, corporate partnerships and pilots. Its Shanghai office is a useful intake route for international teams. Scope, fees, deliverables and investment should be stated separately.
entities.summaryZh: 提供跨境市场拓展、企业合作和试点服务。国际团队可先联系上海办公室，分别确认服务范围、费用、交付内容及投资安排。
entities.address: 4F, Building A, Kehai Building, 800 Naxian Road, Pudong
entities.addressZh: 浦东新区纳贤路800号科海大楼A座4楼

entities.name: Plug and Play China, Shanghai
entities.summary: The operator lists its Yangtze River Delta innovation center at Zhangjiang Guochuang Center. Corporate innovation, office space and venture investment have different admission and commercial terms.
entities.summaryZh: 运营方公布的长三角区域创新中心位于张江国创中心。企业创新项目、办公场地和风险投资各有申请条件及商业条款。
entities.address: 2F, Building 1, Phase II, Zhangjiang Guochuang Center, 899 Dangui Road
entities.addressZh: 浦东新区丹桂路899号张江国创中心二期1幢2楼

entities.name: PwC x Zhangjiang Healthcare Accelerator
entities.zh: 普华永道张江数字医疗加速营
entities.summary: PwC describes a digital healthcare acceleration initiative supported by Pudong and Zhangjiang. The evidence establishes the initiative; a currently accepting cohort and its commercial terms require confirmation.
entities.summaryZh: 普华永道公开介绍过由浦东及张江支持的数字医疗加速项目。资料可确认项目曾开展，当前是否征集项目及具体商业条款仍需咨询。

entities.name: Wuning Science Park
entities.summary: An industrial research and testing environment operated by the Shanghai Electrical Apparatus Research Institute group. Robot and industrial-internet testing are useful entry points for hardware validation.
entities.summaryZh: 由上海电器科学研究所集团运营，提供工业研发及检测服务。机器人和工业互联网团队可关注相关检测及硬件验证资源。
entities.address: Wuning Road area, Putuo; confirm the service building
entities.addressZh: 普陀区武宁路片区，服务楼宇需确认

entities.name: China-Israel Innovation Hub, Shanghai
entities.summary: A district-listed carrier for international collaboration in intelligent manufacturing, AI, robotics and information technology. It supports market, capital and industrial connections; the listing does not guarantee cash support.
entities.summaryZh: 列入区级名录的国际创新合作园区，涉及智能制造、AI、机器人和信息技术，可对接市场、资本及产业资源。列入名录不代表入驻项目一定获得现金资助。

entities.name: Digital Silicon Alley / Hongqiao innovation carriers
entities.zh: 数字硅巷／虹桥创新载体
entities.summary: Changning identifies a layered group of digital incubation and OPC communities. We treat this record as a district routing entry, not a single interchangeable operator or a guaranteed free-workspace offer.
entities.summaryZh: 长宁已公布的数字孵化及OPC社区相关资源。本条提供区级咨询渠道，各载体的运营主体不同，工位是否免费需分别确认。

entities.name: Changyang Campus
entities.summary: The Yangpu brain-inspired intelligence plan identifies Changyang Campus as a southern core, paired with Bay Valley in the north. Suitable for neuromorphic computing and commercial AI collaborations.
entities.summaryZh: 杨浦类脑智能行动方案中的南部核心载体，与北部湾谷科技园联动。可关注类脑计算及AI产业合作。

entities.name: Fuxing Island maker / OPC communities
entities.summary: A May 2026 district policy supports AI-enabled independent founders and maker communities. Ask for an approved community operator, the qualifying activity definition, housing conditions and any service or equity agreement.
entities.summaryZh: 2026年5月杨浦政策支持AI赋能的超级个体及创客社区。申请前需确认运营机构是否符合政策要求，以及活动认定、住房、服务和股权等具体条件。

entities.name: Maqiao AI Innovation Zone
entities.zh: 马桥人工智能创新试验区
entities.summary: The Minhang 2025-2026 park plan links Grand neoBay R&D with Maqiao manufacturing. A useful pathway from a robot prototype to supply-chain and production conversations.
entities.summaryZh: 闵行2025至2026年园区方案提出，衔接大零号湾科研与马桥制造资源。机器人团队可据此寻找从样机到供应链及生产环节的合作方。

entities.name: Shanghai Robot Industrial Park
entities.summary: A robotics industrial park in Gucun, Baoshan. Suitable for industrial robotics supply chains and deployment; we distinguish it from ABB facilities in Pudong and from the broader Baoshan industrial park.
entities.summaryZh: 位于宝山顾村，可对接工业机器人供应链和应用资源。该园区与浦东ABB设施、宝山工业园区是不同主体，联系时应注意区分。
entities.source: 上海机器人产业园地名专项规划

entities.name: Baoshan Industrial Park
entities.summary: The park committee publishes an official contact and provides industrial admission, project attraction, policy coordination and business services. This is a separate park from the Gucun robot industrial park.
entities.summaryZh: 园区管委会提供产业准入、招商、政策协调及企业服务，并公布了官方联系方式。该园区与顾村的上海机器人产业园并非同一园区。

entities.name: G60 Songjiang Xinchuang Industrial Park
entities.summary: An officially profiled industrial park for domestic information-technology innovation. For an AI infrastructure team, establish compatibility requirements, lab access and real customer demand before choosing space.
entities.summaryZh: 官方公开介绍的信创产业园。AI基础设施团队应先确认兼容适配要求、实验室使用条件及实际客户需求，再决定是否租用办公场地。

entities.name: Xicen Science and Innovation Center
entities.summary: A Qingpu innovation area centered on Huawei Lianqiu Lake and Xicen development. It offers an ecosystem connection, not automatic access to Huawei laboratories, procurement or investment.
entities.summaryZh: 青浦以华为练秋湖研发中心和西岑园区为核心的科创片区。可寻找产业合作机会，但进入该片区不代表可以使用华为实验室，或获得采购、投资资格。

entities.name: East China UAV Base
entities.summary: The Jinshan park plan includes test-flight services and a low-altitude incubation platform. Airspace, testing and airworthiness services require separate confirmation from physical workspace.
entities.summaryZh: 金山园区方案涉及的试飞及低空产业孵化平台。空域使用、测试、适航服务和场地租赁，应逐项确认。

entities.name: Jinshan New Materials Incubator
entities.summary: A materials incubation route linked to Carbon Valley Green Bay. Relevant to sensors, electronic materials and manufacturing inputs; specify process equipment and environmental constraints in the inquiry.
entities.summaryZh: 与碳谷绿湾联动的新材料孵化资源，可关注传感材料、电子材料及制造用材料。咨询时宜说明工艺、设备和环境要求。

entities.name: Oriental Beauty Valley
entities.summary: A Fengxian beauty and health industry ecosystem. Relevant AI applications include formulation research, inspection, consumer analysis and supply-chain tools; clinical or laboratory access is a separate arrangement.
entities.summaryZh: 奉贤美丽健康产业集群。AI团队可关注配方研发、检测、消费者分析和供应链工具等应用；临床及实验设施的使用需另行安排。

entities.name: Zhangjiang Chongming Park
entities.summary: The 2025-2026 reform plan sets a framework for ecological innovation. We use the district authority for matching smart agriculture, ecological sensing and marine technology projects to a concrete carrier.
entities.summaryZh: 2025至2026年园区改革方案提出生态创新方向。智慧农业、生态传感和海洋科技项目，可通过区级主管部门咨询具体园区及运营机构。

entities.name: Zhangjiang Hongkou Park / Beikechuang
entities.summary: The park plan gives Beikechuang a coordinating role in incubation, technology transfer and investment services. Request the relevant sub-park and named operating company for a project-specific response.
entities.summaryZh: 园区方案明确由北科创统筹孵化、技术转移及投融资服务。咨询时应明确具体子园区和运营公司，便于获得与项目相关的答复。

entities.name: Huangpu ChuangKa
entities.summary: A youth entrepreneurship service route described by Shanghai HRSS, including up to six months of free workstations in the reported offer. Current capacity, applicant eligibility and additional subsidies must be checked separately.
entities.summaryZh: 上海人社公开报道的青年创业服务项目，曾介绍六个月免费工位等权益。当前名额、申请条件和其他补贴，应分别确认。

entities.name: Lin-gang Science and Innovation City
entities.summary: The January 2026 plan identifies Dishui Lake AI and IC innovation ports and staged development targets. Lin-gang is a functional area, not Shanghai's seventeenth district. Establish the administering boundary before seeking incentives.
entities.summaryZh: 2026年1月方案提出滴水湖AI及IC创新港和分阶段发展目标。临港属于功能区，并非上海第17个行政区；申请政策支持前，需确认项目是否处于相应管理范围内。

entities.name: Shanghai IC Design Industrial Park
entities.zh: 上海集成电路设计产业园
entities.summary: A Zhangjiang chip design ecosystem connecting design and industrial services. A strong starting point for AI chip teams, with specific EDA, IP, tape-out, packaging and testing access negotiated with providers.
entities.summaryZh: 张江集成电路设计产业集聚区，可对接芯片设计和产业服务。AI芯片团队应向具体服务商逐项确认EDA、IP授权、流片、封装和测试条件。

entities.name: Shanghai Integrated Circuit Technology and Industry Promotion Center
entities.zh: 上海集成电路技术与产业促进中心
entities.summary: An IC technical-service entry point that also publishes innovation-voucher guidance. Eligible voucher-covered services are selected on the official platform; a voucher is not a general equipment purchase budget.
entities.summaryZh: 提供集成电路技术服务，并公布科技创新券使用指引。可抵扣哪些服务，需在官方平台确认；创新券不能作为通用设备采购资金。

entities.name: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
entities.summary: A research institution for foundational and applied AI. Its published general contact supports initial routing; open-source resources, collaboration and recruitment are separate pathways, not a generic startup grant.
entities.summaryZh: 开展AI基础及应用研究的科研机构，可通过官网公开联系方式初步咨询。开源资源、科研合作和招聘各有对接渠道，不属于通用创业补贴。
entities.address: L1, International Media Port, 129 Longwen Road, Xuhui
entities.addressZh: 徐汇区龙文路129号国际传媒港L1楼

entities.name: Tongji Autonomous Intelligent Unmanned Systems Center
entities.zh: 同济大学上海自主智能无人系统科学中心
entities.summary: A research collaboration route for autonomous systems. The published office contact is in Zhangjiang. A technical proposal should identify the platform, experiment, data and proposed industrial partner.
entities.summaryZh: 自主智能无人系统研究合作平台，公开办公地址位于张江。联系时宜提交技术方案，说明所需平台、实验、数据及拟合作的产业单位。
entities.address: 3F, Building 2, Tongji Zhangjiang Base, 398 Lianchuang Road
entities.addressZh: 浦东新区联创路398号同济张江基地2号楼3楼

entities.name: Tongji PAI Research Center
entities.summary: The center publishes an industry collaboration entry for localization, sensing, communication and trusted coordination. We use its cooperation contact rather than assuming access through general university admissions.
entities.summaryZh: 提供定位、感知、通信及可信协同领域的产学研合作渠道。本图谱采用合作咨询信息，不把普通招生渠道作为产业合作渠道。
entities.address: Zhixin Building, Tongji Jiading Campus, 4800 Caoan Highway
entities.addressZh: 嘉定区曹安公路4800号同济大学智信馆

entities.name: Roche Accelerator
entities.summary: Roche describes its Shanghai innovation accelerator for the China ecosystem. Relevant to healthcare and AI-enabled discovery teams. Scientific fit, space, collaboration, funding and IP terms are distinct questions.
entities.summaryZh: 罗氏在上海设立、面向中国创新生态的加速器，医疗健康及AI研发团队可了解相关资源。科研匹配、空间、合作、资金和知识产权需分别确认。

entities.name: SAP.iO Foundry Shanghai
entities.summary: The 2021 launch described an equity-free intelligent-manufacturing accelerator. It is included as a historical corporate route; the source does not establish a 2026 Shanghai intake.
entities.summaryZh: 2021年启动公告介绍了不要求出让股权的智能制造加速项目。本条保留为历史企业合作信息，不能据此判断2026年上海仍在征集项目。

entities.name: ABB open innovation / Shanghai robotics
entities.zh: ABB开放创新／上海机器人生态
entities.summary: ABB publishes open-innovation and startup collaboration routes. Its May 2025 Shanghai AI event is evidence of ecosystem activity, not an always-open startup accelerator cohort. Propose a measurable robotics use case.
entities.summaryZh: ABB公布了开放创新及初创企业合作渠道。2025年5月上海AI活动可确认相关活动曾开展，但不代表设有长期开放的加速营。机器人团队可提交目标明确、可量化的应用方案。

entities.name: DroidUp Ecosystem Accelerator
entities.summary: The December 2025 Zhangjiang Robot Valley account reports the accelerator launch. We include it as a robotics industry route and require direct confirmation of intake, pilot access, investment and hardware resources.
entities.summaryZh: 2025年12月张江机器人谷报道记录了该加速器的启动。机器人团队可据此寻找产业合作，但当前项目征集、试点、投资和硬件资源均需向运营方确认。

entities.name: Shanghai AI Public Technology Service Platform
entities.zh: 上海人工智能公共技术服务平台
entities.summary: The PaddlePaddle-linked platform publishes AI training and ecosystem resources. Explore its technical services and developer events; confirm whether a specific training or compute offer carries fees.
entities.summaryZh: 飞桨相关平台提供AI培训及开发者生态资源，可咨询技术服务和活动安排。具体培训或算力服务是否收费，需单独确认。

entities.name: Yangtze River Delta AI+ Joint Innovation Center
entities.summary: An official July 2026 account records the center beginning operations in Qingpu. Confirm the operator, technical scope, Huawei ecosystem interface and actual startup admission before describing a benefit package.
entities.summaryZh: 2026年7月官方报道记录该中心在青浦投入运营。申请前应确认运营主体、技术服务范围、华为生态对接方式及初创企业准入条件，不能自行推定可获得哪些资源。

entities.name: NVIDIA Inception
entities.summary: A free AI startup ecosystem program with no application fee, membership fee or equity requirement. It is not a cash grant. China eligibility, product access and partner benefits must be checked for the specific company.
entities.summaryZh: 面向AI初创企业的生态计划，不收申请费、会员费，也不要求出让股权，但不提供通用现金补助。企业需确认中国区资格、产品供应及合作伙伴权益。

entities.name: Microsoft for Startups
entities.summary: The current program provides Azure-related startup resources through online application. We do not transfer historic Shanghai accelerator terms or global credit ceilings to China-region accounts. Validate the legal entity and region first.
entities.summaryZh: 通过在线申请提供Azure等创业资源。中国区企业和账户的适用条件需单独确认，不能沿用历史上海加速器条款或直接套用全球服务额度上限。

entities.name: AWS China Activate
entities.summary: A China-region startup offer with company, customer and participating investor or incubation relationship conditions. Credits offset eligible services; they are not cash and should not be confused with the separate global AWS offer.
entities.summaryZh: 中国区初创企业支持计划，对企业、新客户身份及投资机构或孵化合作关系设有条件。服务额度只能抵扣规定的云服务，不能兑换现金，也不能直接套用全球AWS规则。

entities.name: STEFG Angel Fund
entities.zh: 上海市大学生科技创业基金会天使基金
entities.summary: The foundation offers distinct interest-free loan and temporary equity support routes for eligible Chinese university entrepreneurs. Nationality, age, ownership, full-time work and company age conditions apply.
entities.summaryZh: 为符合条件的中国籍高校创业者提供免息贷款和临时持股两类资助，另有国籍、年龄、持股、全职创业及企业成立年限等要求。
entities.addressZh: 杨浦区纪念路8号10号楼108室

entities.name: Shanghai Leading Industry Funds
entities.zh: 上海三大先导产业母基金
entities.summary: A state-backed fund platform for leading industries, with AI interests including general AI, computing systems, humanoids, vertical models and edge AI. A fund-of-funds commitment is not a startup award or a direct application entitlement.
entities.summaryZh: 面向三大先导产业的国资基金平台。AI投资方向包括通用智能、算力系统、人形机器人、垂直领域模型和端侧智能。母基金出资不等于企业可直接申领的创业补助。

entities.name: Pudong AI Seed Fund
entities.zh: 浦东人工智能种子基金
entities.summary: Announced in July 2025 at a target size of RMB 2 billion and an initial RMB 500 million tranche. The figure is fund scale, not a per-startup cheque. Seek the manager through Pudong's official ecosystem route.
entities.summaryZh: 2025年7月公布目标规模20亿元、首期5亿元。基金规模不是单家企业可获得的投资额，可通过浦东官方渠道进一步确认管理人及项目接收安排。

entities.name: Shanghai Embodied AI Fund
entities.summary: A state-backed embodied-intelligence investment route announced in April 2025, including core components and edge chips. Confirm the current manager and investment mandate; no uniform cheque size or ownership percentage is established here.
entities.summaryZh: 2025年4月公布的国资具身智能投资渠道，涉及核心零部件和边缘芯片。需确认当前管理人及投资范围，不能推定统一投资金额或持股比例。

entities.name: Shanghai STVC Group
entities.zh: 上海科技创业投资集团
entities.summary: An established science and technology investment group within Shanghai's state-capital ecosystem. Use its official portfolio and manager information to identify the appropriate investment vehicle and stage.
entities.summaryZh: 上海国资背景的科技投资机构。可根据官网公布的投资组合及管理人信息，筛选与行业、发展阶段匹配的具体基金。

entities.name: Qiming Venture Partners
entities.summary: A venture-capital contact route with a published Shanghai office. Send a concise investment case and confirm sector and stage fit. The general contact inbox is not a guarantee of an investment review.
entities.summaryZh: 设有上海办公室的风险投资机构。联系时可提交简明融资材料，并确认投资领域及阶段是否匹配；通过综合咨询渠道联系，不代表项目一定进入投资评审。
entities.address: Room 3901, Jinmao Tower, 88 Century Boulevard, Pudong
entities.addressZh: 浦东新区世纪大道88号金茂大厦3901室

entities.name: Caohejing Development Zone
entities.summary: The park operator publishes enterprise and intellectual-property service routes. Confirm the specific sub-park and operating address; the Caohejing name covers multiple development locations.
entities.summaryZh: 运营方公布了企业服务及知识产权服务渠道。漕河泾涉及多个开发区域，需明确具体子园区及实际经营地址。

entities.name: Zizhu National Hi-Tech Park / ET Space
entities.zh: 紫竹国家高新区／创业孵化器ET空间
entities.summary: The park-owned incubator connects startups with the software, avionics and manufacturing ecosystem. Its operator describes industry challenges and collaborative innovation; current admission, space and fees require an intake discussion.
entities.summaryZh: 紫竹国家高新区所属孵化器，可对接软件、航空电子和制造业资源。运营方介绍了产业挑战及协同创新项目，当前入驻条件、场地和费用需进一步咨询。

entities.name: Hongqiao International Youth Innovation Hub
entities.summary: Opened in July 2026 as a youth innovation and business-service hub in Hongqiao. The reported workstation offer depends on qualification and available space, not simply arrival at the transport hub.
entities.summaryZh: 2026年7月启用的青年创业及企业服务平台。报道中的工位支持取决于申请资格及场地余量，并非到达虹桥交通枢纽即可享受。

entities.name: East Hongqiao International Youth Innovation Center
entities.zh: 东虹桥国际青年科创中心
entities.summary: Changning's official May 2026 account describes a hub for AI-enabled independent founders, combining incubation, AI services, talent support and global business resources. Confirm the current operator's selection and service terms.
entities.summaryZh: 长宁2026年5月官方报道介绍的AI超级个体创新平台，整合孵化、AI服务、人才和国际商务资源。当前运营机构遴选情况及服务条款，需进一步确认。

entities.name: Shibei Hi-Tech Park / Shutong Valley & Daning Carriers
entities.zh: 市北高新园区／数通链谷与大宁科创载体
entities.summary: Jing'an's 2026-2028 AI demonstration plan and district carrier program anchor big-data, blockchain (Shutong Valley), cloud computing and enterprise AI workspaces across Shibei Hi-Tech Park, Daning and Suhewan. Confirm the specific carrier operator, data-compliance services and tenancy terms.
entities.summaryZh: 静安2026至2028年AI示范区方案以市北高新、数通链谷、大宁和苏河湾等为核心，集聚大数据、区块链、云计算及企业级AI资源。申请前需明确具体运营主体、数据合规服务及入驻条款。

entities.name: Xihe Optic Valley Optoelectronic Incubator
entities.zh: 羲和光谷光电产业孵化器
entities.summary: An optoelectronic and photonics incubator launched in Jiading in November 2025 to support scientist-founded teams in optical sensing, laser systems and AI hardware components. Confirm optical lab equipment, engineering support and commercial terms before admission.
entities.summaryZh: 2025年11月在嘉定启用，面向科学家创业团队，提供光学传感、激光系统及AI硬件零部件领域的孵化支持。入驻前应确认实验设备、工程服务和商业条款。

entities.name: Zhangjiang AI Innovation Town
entities.zh: 张江人工智能创新小镇
entities.summary: A 2-square-kilometer core zone in Zhangjiang Science City with 700,000 sqm of industrial space, spatiotemporal digital infrastructure and linked compute, model and corpus vouchers. Confirm whether the company's registered and operating address falls inside the designated town boundary.
entities.summaryZh: 位于张江科学城核心区的2平方公里创新集聚区，规划70万平方米产业空间，布局时空量子城市数字底座，并配套算力券、模型券和语料券。申请专项支持前，应确认企业注册地和实际经营地均在核定范围内。

entities.name: Shanghai Integrated Circuit R&D Center
entities.zh: 上海集成电路研发中心
entities.summary: A shared integrated-circuit research and engineering platform in Zhangjiang supporting process development, device verification and IP testing. Request a technical scoping review and written quotation for wafer or testing runs.
entities.summaryZh: 位于张江的集成电路公共研发与工程平台，提供工艺开发、器件验证及IP测试服务。流片或测试合作需先完成技术评估，并索取书面报价。

entities.name: Shanghai Technology Innovation Center
entities.summary: The municipal science-and-technology entrepreneurship service institution coordinating Shanghai's high-quality incubator cultivation system, innovation vouchers, technology SME filings and the Startup in Shanghai portal.
entities.summaryZh: 市级科技创业服务机构，负责上海高质量孵化器培育、科技创新券、科技型中小企业服务，以及“上海科创在线／创·在上海”等平台相关工作。

entities.name: Shanghai Tsinghua International Innovation Center
entities.zh: 上海清华国际创新中心
entities.summary: A strategic research and technology-transfer platform in Putuo's "One Axis, One Park, One Center" layout, connecting university engineering laboratories with Yangtze River Delta industrial applications.
entities.summaryZh: 普陀“一轴一园一中心”科创布局中的重点平台，连接高校工程实验室与长三角产业化应用资源。

entities.name: Oriental Beauty Valley Life Messenger Gene Drug Base
entities.zh: 东方美谷·生命信使基因药物创新产业基地
entities.summary: Opened in April 2025 in Fengxian to connect gene and nucleic-acid drug R&D, AI-assisted molecular design, shared laboratories and pilot manufacturing. Confirm biosafety level, cleanroom specs and admission terms.
entities.summaryZh: 2025年4月在奉贤开园，面向基因与核酸药物创新，可关注AI辅助分子设计、共享实验室与中试生产的衔接。入驻前应确认生物安全等级、洁净室规格及服务条款。

entities.name: China (Shanghai) Public Practicing Base for Entrepreneurs
entities.zh: 中国（上海）创业者公共实训基地
entities.summary: A municipal HRSS-backed public entrepreneurship training, prototyping and incubation base in Yangpu linking founder skills training, product trial spaces and startup service agencies.
entities.summaryZh: 位于杨浦的市人社公共创业实训与孵化基地，提供创业培训、产品试制场地及创业服务机构对接。

entities.name: Songjiang University Town Sci-Tech Source
entities.summary: A Songjiang district initiative backed by a September 2026 special-fund notice to link the seven universities in Songjiang University Town with technology-transfer platforms and incubation operators.
entities.summaryZh: 松江2026年9月专项资金通知涉及的产学研成果转化载体，连接大学城高校、科技成果转化平台和创新创业空间运营机构。

entities.name: Chongming Enterprise Technology Center & Eco-Innovation Route
entities.zh: 崇明区企业技术中心与生态科创平台
entities.summary: Coordinated by the Chongming Economic Commission (14th batch call issued in May 2026) alongside district science authorities to support enterprise R&D centers in ecological tech, green manufacturing and smart agriculture.
entities.summaryZh: 崇明企业研发平台相关服务。区经委于2026年5月发布第十四批申报通知，区科委协同推进生态科技、绿色制造和智慧农业等领域的企业技术中心建设。

entities.name: Huangpu Fintech & Entrepreneurship Companion Hub
entities.zh: 黄浦金融科技集聚与创业陪跑计划
entities.summary: Combines Huangpu's five-year fintech industry clustering direction with the HRSS "Entrepreneurship Companion Plan" mentor and service network for early-stage digital and financial technology founders.
entities.summaryZh: 将黄浦未来五年金融科技发展方向与区人社“创业陪跑计划”导师服务相衔接，可关注早期数字科技和金融科技团队的创业辅导。

entities.name: Hongkou Science & Technology Entrepreneurship Center
entities.zh: 虹口区科技创业中心与博士后创新基地
entities.summary: District public entrepreneurship center and postdoctoral innovation practice base route supporting tech SMEs, green-shipping digital tools and R&D talent settlement in Hongkou.
entities.summaryZh: 虹口公共科技创业中心及博士后创新实践基地相关服务，可供科技型中小企业、绿色航运数字化团队及研发人才咨询。

entities.name: JLABS Shanghai
entities.summary: An operator-listed life-sciences incubation site in Zhangjiang with an application route. For AI-enabled healthcare, clarify scientific fit, laboratory requirements, residency pricing, IP and any separate challenge or investment terms.
entities.summaryZh: 运营方公布的张江生命科学孵化基地，设有申请渠道。AI医疗团队应确认研究方向、实验需求、入驻费用和知识产权安排；挑战赛或投资项目另有条件。

entities.name: Bayer Co.Lab Shanghai
entities.summary: Bayer's September 2024 Shanghai site launch describes shared laboratories and office space for early biotech teams in SH-INNO Park. Confirm available residency and collaboration terms; the historic capacity is not a current vacancy count.
entities.summaryZh: 拜耳2024年9月启动资料介绍了SH-INNO园区内面向早期生物科技团队的共享实验室及办公场地。当前入驻与合作条款需进一步确认，历史公布容量不代表实时空位。

entities.name: Siemens startup / Xcelerator ecosystem
entities.zh: 西门子初创企业与Xcelerator生态
entities.summary: Siemens publishes a startup connection and marketplace route for industrial solutions, with a separate China Xcelerator platform. Marketplace onboarding and industrial partnerships are distinct from a funding award.
entities.summaryZh: 西门子提供工业解决方案相关的初创企业合作及市场平台，中国另设Xcelerator平台。平台入驻、产业合作与资金资助是不同事项。

entities.name: BMW Group Startup Garage
entities.summary: BMW describes a venture-client route for evaluating startup solutions for products, services and internal processes. Validate the responsible China business owner and pilot requirements; venture-client activity is not necessarily equity investment.
entities.summaryZh: 宝马通过“风险客户”（venture client）模式，评估初创企业的产品、服务及内部流程解决方案。需确认中国业务对接人及试点要求；作为早期客户开展合作，并不一定涉及股权投资。

entities.name: Shanghai Innovation Institute / Beiyang AI founder network
entities.zh: 上海创智学院／北杨人工智能创业网络
entities.summary: SII and Caohejing jointly operate the Chuangzhi Future Center for research-led AI founders; Beiyang AI Accelerator supports later market and supply-chain connections. Institute-affiliated incubation is not an unrestricted public admission offer. Ask the operator about affiliation, IP, company formation and current external-team access.
entities.summaryZh: 上海创智学院与漕河泾共同运营创智未来中心，面向科研型AI创业者；北杨AI加速器进一步对接市场及产业链资源。相关孵化服务不一定向所有团队开放，需确认申请人身份、知识产权、企业设立及校外团队准入条件。

entities.name: National-Local Humanoid Robot Innovation Center / pilot platform
entities.zh: 国家地方共建人形机器人创新中心／中试服务平台
entities.summary: The center links robot data collection, training and physical validation with a pilot-production platform operated with Shanghai Electric. The July 2026 announcement describes industry-facing trial production, testing and scenario validation. Ask for compatibility, queue, sample ownership, safety responsibilities and a written service quotation.
entities.summaryZh: 国地中心将机器人数据采集、训练和真机验证，与联合上海电气建设的中试平台衔接。2026年7月公告介绍了试制、检测和场景验证服务。使用前需确认设备兼容性、排期、样机归属、安全责任及书面报价。

entities.name: Lin-gang Zero Cube OPC community
entities.summary: A Lin-gang Group community for solo founders and small teams, with startup and living-service teams and AI-Store resource access. The August 2026 operator report describes three rent-free office years followed by two half-price years for qualifying projects. Housing, loans, vouchers and admission have separate conditions; confirm the current tenancy contract.

Request the receiving manager and current investment terms; camp attendance is not an investment award.

entities.name: WAIC / Future Tech venture network
entities.zh: 世界人工智能大会／Future Tech创投生态
entities.summary: The 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference included a Future Tech venture network connecting selected startups and investors. The July 2026 event has ended; this is a networking and future-event route, not a permanent incubator or an open funding call. Ask the organizer about the next startup selection, exhibition fees and investor sessions.

Foreign businesses should ask whether a locally incorporated foreign-invested entity is required, then confirm admission, IP, laboratory access and fees. No standard grant or foreign-founder entitlement is established.

Confirm the specific operator, legal entity, customs boundary, sector permissions and data handling before incurring costs. citywideFunding.name: Shanghai pre-registration incubation rent subsidy
citywideFunding.zh: 上海创业孵化期场地房租补贴
citywideFunding.amount: Actual workstation cost before registration; up to RMB 10,000 and at most 6 months
citywideFunding.amountZh: 补贴注册前实际承担的工位费，最高1万元，最长6个月
citywideFunding.eligibility: Teams entering a municipal demonstration incubation base and establishing a qualifying startup organization during incubation. Only the period from admission to registration is covered. Ask the base and district employment service for the current evidence and filing procedure.
citywideFunding.eligibilityZh: 入驻市级创业孵化示范基地，并在孵化期内成功创办规定创业组织的团队。仅覆盖入孵至注册之间的工位费，须向基地及本区就业服务部门确认凭证与办理流程。
citywideFunding.status: Policy in force; call not confirmed open
citywideFunding.deadline: Policy through 31 Dec 2027; confirm district procedure
citywideFunding.deadlineZh: 政策至2027年12月31日，需确认本区办理流程

citywideFunding.name: Shanghai first-startup one-off subsidy
citywideFunding.zh: 上海首次创业一次性补贴
citywideFunding.amount: One-off RMB 8,000 for qualifying founders
citywideFunding.amountZh: 符合条件的首次创业者一次性8000元
citywideFunding.eligibility: Shanghai-hukou graduates within 2 years of graduation or recognized local people with employment difficulties. First qualifying startup must have operated for 1 year and paid employee social insurance for at least one person for 6 months. This is not a universal incorporation award.
citywideFunding.eligibilityZh: 本市户籍、毕业2年内高校毕业生，或本市就业困难人员。须首次创办规定创业组织满1年，并依法至少为1人缴纳职工社保满6个月，并非普遍性公司注册奖励。
citywideFunding.status: Policy in force; call not confirmed open
citywideFunding.deadline: Policy through 31 Dec 2027; confirm district procedure
citywideFunding.deadlineZh: 政策至2027年12月31日，需确认本区办理流程
